name: NEXUS Live-Eval Result Schema
description: Schema for a single per-prompt evaluation record produced by backend.services.eval_service.evaluate_deck. Designed to be deterministic and offline-measurable. Per-category scores set to null mean 'not measurable from a deck dict alone' and require an out-of-band measurement (e.g. visual diff, runtime telemetry).

result_record.prompt_id: string (must match an id in benchmarks/prompts.json)
result_record.notes: list[string] (human-readable reasons; includes 'unmeasured' notes for null categories)
result_record.ran_live: bool (true only if NEXUS_RUN_LIVE_EVAL=true was set and a real generation produced this deck)
result_record.fixture_label: string|null (set to the fixture name when ran_live=false)
result_record.timestamp_utc: string ISO-8601 (set by harness; tests may stub)
